##### Project general facts

Novara Residence by Cavara Developments emerges as a new light for every chapter of home, an elegant low-rise residence, that is designed as an expression of light, balance, and timeless architecture. Inspired by the meaning of its name, this intimate collection of one and two-bedroom residences embraces natural daylight, creating bright, open spaces that feel calm and inviting from the moment you arrive. Every residence and shared space has been thoughtfully crafted to offer privacy, comfort, and enduring sophistication, with a refined palette of white stone, light oak, soft boucle textures, brushed brass, and rich walnut accents that deliver warmth and understated luxury.

The interiors of Novara Residence are designed to hold every chapter of life, where panoramic windows provide abundant natural light and living spaces rise to a ceiling height of over three metres, creating an atmosphere of unparalleled openness and serenity. Each home features a smart home system powered by TIS, bringing lighting, climate, security, and shading together under one intuitive platform, controlled from a single app or wall panel. The thoughtful inclusion of smart locks, chiller-free air conditioning, and generous layouts ensures that technology serves daily life quietly and seamlessly, while each typical floor accommodates just six apartments, preserving a rare sense of privacy and exclusivity.

Beyond the exquisite residences, Novara Residence offers a curated collection of amenities designed to enhance wellbeing, relaxation, and community connection. Residents enjoy a serene swimming pool surrounded by a sun deck with comfortable loungers, a fully equipped gym with panoramic views over Arjan, and a warm, welcoming lobby that sets the tone for a place that feels unmistakably like home. The development also features a beautifully landscaped courtyard and a shared living room that invites neighbours to become familiar faces, creating a lifestyle that is closer to nature and further from the noise of the city.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan stands as one of Dubai's most sought-after family communities, a green and growing neighbourhood where contemporary living is surrounded by lush greenery and renowned attractions, including the Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden. This peaceful, family-friendly community combines nature, everyday convenience, and excellent connectivity, offering a vibrant lifestyle with a true sense of belonging. Residents benefit from nearby schools, healthcare facilities, cafes, restaurants, wellness facilities, essential services, and boutique retail, all while remaining well connected to Dubai's key business districts and major roads.

Life within Arjan is defined by its exceptional connectivity and strategic location at the crossroads of Dubai's major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, and Sheikh Zayed Road, ensuring effortless travel across the city. The neighbourhood's proximity to leading international schools, including Nord Anglia International School, Safa Community School, and GEMS World Academy, alongside world-class healthcare at Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, makes it an ideal choice for families. With the future Metro Blue Line station opening nearby and shopping destinations including My City Centre Al Barsha, Dubai Hills Mall, and Mall of the Emirates all within easy reach, every convenience is always close at hand.

The surroundings of Arjan offer a wealth of attractions and experiences that cater to every interest and lifestyle, from the breathtaking beauty of Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden to world-class golf courses and entertainment venues. The area's strong investment potential, with attractive rental yields and strong capital appreciation prospects, makes it one of Dubai's fastest-growing residential communities. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquillity of a nature-infused community with the dynamic allure of one of the world's most exciting cities.
